verdict.rationale: The evidence shows rule-based card authorization controls and spend controls, plus AgentOS as a toolkit for AI agents acting on the account. None of it documents AI automatically flagging anomalous or out-of-policy transactions for review. Static authorization rules are an adjacent control, and AgentOS is a developer building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
